tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get public details of a specific business by its slug. Returns name, about, hours, tier, rating, and citation URL. Only Blue-tier-and-above businesses carry member ratings — free-tier businesses always report rating 0. WhatsApp/phone/address require a keyed connection.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: Search for job postings in Costa Rica. Returns title, employer, type (full/part/contract), salary, city, and URL. WhatsApp apply link requires a keyed connection.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: List upcoming events in Costa Rica. Returns title, date, venue, city, organizer, and URL.

tools.name: get_specials
tools.description: List active deals and offers in Costa Rica. Returns title, discount, business, city, expiry, and URL. WhatsApp requires a keyed connection.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: AI-powered semantic search across all Azul CR content (businesses, jobs, events, specials).
